newsitem.title: USA: Medizone acts to get former CEO off board.
newsitem.headline: Medizone acts to get former CEO off board.

text.p: Medizone International Inc said Wednesday it plans to "take action" to remove from the board Joseph Latino, who was recently terminated as president, chief executive and chairman.
Medizone said its newly elected board requested Latino's resignation as a member of the board, but he declined.

Medizone said that according to the company's by-laws Latino cannot automatically be removed from the board. Medizone did not specify what sort of action it would take and was not immediately available for comment.

The company also said it elected four new directors to its board and authorized Sand Dollar Solutions, a California limited partnership, to receive warrants to buy $11 million in common stock to be used to raise funds for Medizone.
The company also said Milton Adair replaces Latino as president and chief executive.
Adair was formerly president and chief executive of Biomune Systems Inc.
Latino's position as president, cheif executive and chairman was terminated by the company's old board on May 14.
